title: Team Leader - Marketing
sourceText: Job Description: Team Lead – Marketing Location: Gurugram, Haryana Experience: 5+ years Salary: Up to ₹7.2 LPAEmployment Type: Full-time About the Role We are looking for a driven and versatile Team Lead – Marketing to plan, execute, and manage marketing initiatives across digital, brand, and offline channels. The ideal candidate will lead a small marketing team, own campaign performance end-to-end, and work closely with sales and leadership to drive brand visibility and lead generation. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital (SEO, social media, paid ads), content/brand, and offline/events channels Lead, mentor, and manage a team of marketing executives, assigning tasks and reviewing performance Develop and manage the marketing calendar, ensuring timely execution of campaigns Track and report on campaign performance (leads generated, engagement, ROI) and optimize strategies accordingly Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, and freelancers as needed Manage social media presence, website content, and marketing collateral Plan and execute offline marketing activities such as events, exhibitions, and local promotions Collaborate with the sales team to align marketing efforts with business goals Manage marketing budget allocation and ensure cost-effective execution Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field (MBA preferred) Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing, with at least 1-2 years in a team lead or supervisory role Strong understanding of digital marketing tools and platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO tools, email marketing platforms) Experience in content/brand marketing and offline event management Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze campaign metrics and report insights Proficiency in MS Office/Google Workspace; familiarity with CRM or marketing automation tools is a plus What We Offer Competitive salary up to ₹7.2 LPA Opportunity to lead and grow a marketing team Collaborative and fast-paced work environment Location: Gurugram, Haryana Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month Work Location: In person
